subject: Invoice delivery & EDI constraints — billing contact and portal opt-in
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@gemini-analytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@gemini-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 08:31:22 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery preference + EDI spec attached

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for taking this — quick one from our AP group. Attached is our AP spec (ap_spec_v2.xlsx). We have an existing EDI pipeline that accepts X12 810 invoices and direct SFTP for PDF batches. Geminis' procurement team prefers electronic ingestion where possible. A few constraints:

- Our SFTP connector only accepts PDF batches with a specific naming convention (GEMINI_INV_YYYYMMDD.pdf).
- EDI 810 mapping is strict: we require your invoice to include our PO number in the N1/PAY loop and VAT fields mapped to element REF02 when applicable.
- We would like invoices delivered to our portal (ap@gemini-analytics.com) via SFTP ingestion. If that is not feasible this quarter, email copies to ap@gemini-analytics.com are acceptable temporarily.

Could you confirm which delivery path Redwood can support this quarter and whether the portal opt-in is required to enable automated matching for our PO numbers? Also, who will be our billing contact for routing exceptions?

Appreciate a short list of next steps and expected timeline.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
AP Manager
Gemini Analytics

Attachment: ap_spec_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 68KB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@gemini-analytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference + EDI spec attached

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the spec and the clear constraints. Short answer: we can support both routes, but there are trade-offs and a short operational gap while we validate your EDI mapping. Quick plan below.

Options (details in order of recommended path):

1) Portal/SFTP ingestion (recommended for automation)
   - We can push PDF batches to your SFTP name pattern, and our billing ops will attach the PO number in the filename when present.
   - Requires a one-week mapping and test window with your team to confirm naming + matching rules.

2) X12 810 EDI (long-term, high-automation)
   - We can produce 810s but need a mapping pass. That will likely take 2–3 weeks for mapping + test cycles.

3) Email copies (short-term fallback)
   - We can send invoice PDFs to ap@gemini-analytics.com immediately; however, automated matching will be manual until we finish SFTP/EDI work.

Billing contact / owner: I will own coordination across our side. I’ve looped in Connor from our infra/ops team who will scope the mapping work and Marissa from Billing Ops who will handle SFTP PDF pushes and sample invoices.

Next steps I propose:
- Connor: can you review the attached spec and confirm the mapping effort estimate? (Cc'd)
- Elena / AP: can you provide a test SFTP dropbox and a sample PO we can use for matching?
- Marissa: we’ll prepare a test PDF batch and an invoice_sample.pdf for your ingestion test.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute call today to speed approvals.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for the context, Rachel. I reviewed the attachment quickly. High level:

- For SFTP/PDF ingestion: we can generate the filename convention on our side (GEMINI_INV_YYYYMMDD.pdf) as part of our billing export. That is the fastest route for Q3–Q4. Expect about 3 business days to add the filename logic and one additional day for an internal QA run.

- For X12 810: Redwood currently produces a basic EDI 810 variant for several customers, but your REF02 requirement and N1/PAY loop expectations require a custom mapping. I estimate 10–14 business days for mapping + test cycles with your team (including ERP test).

A couple of clarifying Qs for AP team:
1) Do you require line-level tax elements in the 810 (we can include but need exact element IDs)?
2) Is there a test SFTP user and a sample PO you can drop so Marissa can attempt an ingest?

I’ll log a small epic with Billing Ops to track work: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INVOICE-321 — I’ve added the AP schema to the ticket.

Connor O'Brien
Platform Integrations (Redwood Inference)

Billing Ops here. Quick operational readout and request.

- For immediate coverage into Q3/Q4 we can enable SFTP PDF drops to your ingestion path on a trial basis. We will need the SFTP endpoint + credentials and a sample PO dropped by your team so we can confirm matching rules.
- If the EDI 810 path is required right away, note that our current EDI partner charges a mapping fee and requires a signed interface addendum. That will push timelines by ~2 weeks and require procurement approval on both sides.

2) Drop a sample PO file in the folder so we can test matching.
